experiment: E-ISO4: joint side-symmetric (SHARED) grade-map recalibration of the eFV 5-bucket distribution -- FINAL calibration attempt against this data vintage (owner: one more attempt)
spec: gate pre-registered in docs/audit-2026-07/AUDIT_FINDINGS.md section E-ISO4; predecessors: E-ISO3 data/xfv_grade_recal3_eval.json, E-ISO2 data/xfv_grade_recal_eval.json, X-ISO data/xfv_isotonic_eval.json

method.base_distribution: shipped seam, forward-chained OOF (reused verbatim from tools/efv_isotonic_lab.py oof_rows): lean ridge + in-fold linear scale calibration -> xfv_war -> realized_implied_fv -> p_bucket_given_fv (uncalibrated 'before')
method.shared_grade_map: ONE strictly-increasing monotone map g(grade) fit on the POOLED (both sides) OOF rows: pooled binned effective-grade inversion (per grade bin, argmax over the dense grade grid of the KM-weighted realized-bucket log-likelihood, each row scored under its OWN side's anchor table at the SAME candidate grade) + weighted PAVA + strict identity blend f(g)=(1-eps)*iso(g)+eps*g, eps=0.01; applied IDENTICALLY to both sides so cross-side rank order == shipped-grade order
method.formulation_a: p_after = p_bucket_given_fv(g(grade), side); the anchor table is untouched, only the shared grade it is evaluated at moves
method.formulation_b: ranking grade = g(grade) (identical to a); DISPLAYED distribution = shared-map base further corrected by a per-side OOF per-bucket isotonic residual (fit on decision_year<Y rows' shared-map base), renormalized onto the simplex; residual never affects ranking order
method.ranking: the board ranks by the shared recalibrated grade g(grade); conditions 2 and 3 are measured on g(grade) (0 by construction under a shared strictly-increasing map); the verbatim E-ISO3 expected-WAR cross-side instrument is reported as a diagnostic only
method.oof_protocol: shared map (and formulation-b residual) for eval cohort Y fit ONLY on rows with decision_year < Y (pooled across sides for the map, per side for the residual); chain years 2016-2023; no row ever calibrates itself; no same-player leakage
method.realized_bucket: 6yr-average annual WAR (target_censored/6) binned by the engine bands: <0.5 bust / 0.5-1.5 bench / 1.5-2.5 regular / 2.5-4.0 good / 4.0+ star
method.pool: full labeled matrix per side (debuted + busts, bust_recent excluded), matching efv_model.oos_grades
method.rank_metric: ranking grade g(grade); shipped baseline = OOF eFV grade

condition_1_brier_logloss.definition: pooled Brier AND log-loss improve; each side's pooled Brier AND log-loss improve; every pooled bucket improves on both metrics; no bucket materially worse (rel > 0.01 on either metric) pooled OR on either side

condition_2_rank_preservation.definition: within-(side, eval-year) Spearman of the ranking grade g(grade) equals the shipped grade Spearman exactly (abs diff < 1e-9) in every cell

condition_3_cross_side_by_year.definition: for EVERY evaluation year 2020-2023, the cross-side pooled Spearman of the ranking grade g(grade) (both sides, that year only) has delta >= -0.002 vs the shipped grade (0 by construction under the shared map)

condition_4_tier_reliability.definition: every FV tier >= 45 improves (gap_after < gap_before); no tier (any grade) worsens by more than 0.005 absolute

loss_ledger.experiment: E-ISO4: joint side-symmetric SHARED grade-map recalibration of the eFV 5-bucket distribution (both formulations)
loss_ledger.hypothesis: tying the two sides to ONE shared monotone grade map removes the cross-side rank churn that killed X-ISO/E-ISO2/E-ISO3, so the real, large FV45+ calibration gain finally clears every gate condition
loss_ledger.what_was_tried: (a) one shared strictly-increasing grade map minimizing pooled calibration loss, applied identically to both sides; (b) the same shared map for ranking + per-side OOF per-bucket isotonic residual bucket tables for the displayed distribution
loss_ledger.disposition: NO SHIP. Per the pre-registration this is the FINAL calibration attempt against this data vintage across all formulations. Harness (tools/efv_grade_recal4_lab.py) + this artifact are the committed loss; revisit only with 2024+ cohorts.
